statement:
∀ f : Module.End ℤ M, ∃ F : Module.End (ZMod p) (ModN (Reduction.MR p M) p),
 ∀ u : Reduction.MR p M, F (ModN.mkQ p u) = ModN.mkQ p (f.baseChange (Reduction.loc p) u)
proof:
intro f
let g : Reduction.MR p M →+ ModN (Reduction.MR p M) p :=
  (ModN.mkQ p).comp (f.baseChange (Reduction.loc p)).toAddMonoidHom
have hg : ∀ u, p • g u = 0 := by
  intro u
  rw [← Nat.cast_smul_eq_nsmul (ZMod p), CharP.cast_eq_zero (ZMod p) p, zero_smul]
let F : Module.End (ZMod p) (ModN (Reduction.MR p M) p) :=
  ModN.liftEquiv'.symm ⟨g, hg⟩
exact ⟨F, fun u => rfl⟩

checked : ∀ (p : ℕ) (l : ℤ) (K : Type u_2) [fieldK : Field K] (V : Type u_1) [addV : AddCommGroup V]
  [modV : _root_.Module ℂ V] (act : ↥Reduction.SL →ₗ⁅ℂ⁆ End ℂ V) (x y h : ↥Reduction.SL) (v0 : V) (M : Submodule ℤ V),
  Nat.Prime p →
    CharP K p →
      0 ≤ l ∧ l < ↑p →
        Reduction.localizationFacts p l (act x) (act y) (act h) v0 M →
          ∀ (f : End ℤ ↥M),
            ∃ F,
              ∀ (u : Reduction.MR p M),
                F ((ModN.mkQ p) u) = (ModN.mkQ p) ((LinearMap.baseChange (↥(Reduction.loc p)) f) u)
'YuiAuxiliary.checked' depends on axioms: [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]
